migration.migration_reason: Legacy paid evidence is scientifically unchanged; only the scoped Task Packet/fingerprint representation changed. Every non-scoped dependency and selected prompt component was proved identical, except that Learnability may project away the explicitly Semantic Compression-only worker-core output-transport section after the remaining worker rules compare byte-for-byte.

condition.i3_structural_surface_perturba.description: Two independently generated transformation sets (Set A seed=101: statement terminator, function keyword, argument separator perturbed; Set B seed=202: block markers, declaration separator, return keyword perturbed) applied with equal transformation budget (3 substitutions each) per llm_learnability.structural_surface_transformation_sets=2. Model under test (fresh session per trial) was given only the pseudo-grammar description and had to translate to real TypeScript.
condition.i3_structural_surface_perturba.score_basis: Both primary transformation sets produced compiling, semantically faithful TypeScript translations on first attempt (Correct@1=1.0, Compile Success=1.0 across both sets); condition score normalized to 100 on the 0-100 scale using the weighted metric definitions in section 10.6 (Compile/Parse Success, Correct@1, Test Pass Rate all satisfied for both sets; no repairs needed so Repair metrics are vacuously satisfied).

condition.i4_novel_rule_generalization.description: Synthetic overlay rule NR-1 (seed=7), defined only in learnability_reference_pack.md and never part of real TypeScript: functions returning number must be prefixed qz_ iff they contain an internal mutable let. Rule mechanically validated via scripts/check_nr1.py, and removal of the prefix leaves semantics unchanged (per llm_learnability.novel_rule_generalization_trials_per_language=1).
condition.i4_novel_rule_generalization.score_basis: Model correctly inferred and applied the novel NR-1 naming rule to both the mutable-state function (added qz_ prefix) and the pure/const-only function (withheld qz_ prefix) on the first attempt, with code compiling under tsc --strict; condition score normalized to 100 on the 0-100 scale (Compile/Parse Success=1.0, Correct@1=1.0, Specification Compliance=1.0 for the single primary trial per language).

evidence.note: Primary counts used: structural_surface_transformation_sets=2 (i3), novel_rule_generalization_trials_per_language=1 (i4), matching primary.json llm_learnability frozen configuration. Assigned language TypeScript only; no other language keys present per assigned_requirements.json.
